ignoreValues.reason: Both instances checked against source: body{overflow-x:hidden} only clips the X axis to prevent a horizontal scrollbar (a standard, benign technique, not a tooltip/menu clip); .portada{overflow:hidden} is the hero image-carousel container intentionally clipping its own crossfade slides to its bounds, which is the entire point of the carousel. Neither wraps an escaping tooltip/menu/popover. Verified in Assessment B of /impeccable critique.
